description: This file defines the AppTheme class responsible for providing light and dark theme configurations for a Flutter application. It sets color schemes and styles for various UI components such as app bars, progress indicators, buttons, text, and chips.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class that provides themed data for light and dark modes in a Flutter app.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for the light theme, including color schemes and widget styles.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for the dark theme, including color schemes and widget styles.
